Superlatives are used to give the maximum noun’s description.

To create a statement using a superlative, you need to take into account that we use adjectives. These adjectives need to be modified according to the number of syllables it has.

For short adjectives or one syllable adjectives you need to follow this structure:

The + Adjective (est)

Example:

Color seems to be the easiest element of all.

Changing shapes is the fastest process.

Look at the following chart to know more short adjectives:

Although designs are different from one to other, they follow the same basic principles.

Any designer must know that besides inspiration there are more characteristic when creating the design. There are some important basic elements that need to be considered in order to create design.

The most basic and important elements include line, shape, color, texture, space, typography, scale, emphasis, balance and harmony.

The line has to do with every single two points connected, a line is used to divide spaces or separate contents. The shape has to do with every single geometric figure included in the design. Color shows different emotions to the visitors or viewers.

Texture is related to the 2D or 3D dimensional surfaces used by designers. Space must be really well utilized since blank spaces must not appear in any segment of the design. Typography and scale are linked together; they have to do with size and font used for texts. Emphasis is how the designer creates a balance between the information that is shown on the surface. Harmony is the final product; it has to do with how all of the previous elements mentioned before are put together.

Andres: What are we going to have to take into account for the new web page design?

Laura: First of all, we have got to be really inspired, so we can create the best design for the proposal.

Andres: Remember that creating an amazing design doesn’t depend on inspirational mottos only. We need to apply harmonically the best elements to design accordingly.

Laura: What are those elements that you refer to?

Andres: We have: line, color, shapes, space, typography, and size. Well very important, we need to consider people. People's opinions are essential.

Laura: Wow! There are a lot of elements that we have got to take into consideration. I know the line is the worthiest element because it helps to divide spaces or separate content. Color seems to be the easiest element of all. However, it is really important and we, as sketchers, should take a minute to think about its impact on the design. Shapes are the greatest way to add interest to your design. It has got to do with any geometric figure and the relationship among these three characteristics is really important, since color and lines define boundaries and interaction of these shapes. I don’t remember what space has got to do with.

Andres: Well, space deals with all of the blank spaces that are left on the web page. The easiest way to solve this predicament is to use blank space to include shapes as in any other part of the page.

Laura: Okay, what about typography and size?

Andres: Typography is the hardest tool to define the style of the words. It shows how serious the web page is, so the font, color, and shapes that we use must be appropriate. Size is the trickiest element to be taken into account when designing a web page. It plays with the symmetry and asymmetry of the images in relations with the words and other items on the screen. In summary, the best way to get the perfect design proposal is to mix all of the elements up, looking to ask people what they think and feel about our work, because we are basically working for other people for our beloved people.

Laura: We are going to think and organize all elements before we start our design, and contacting as many people we can in order to have proper feedback from our work.
